orchestration.summary: Ray execution with MLflow and Weights & Biases tooling
orchestration.smoke:
import ray
ray.init(include_dashboard=False, num_cpus=1, ignore_reinit_error=True, logging_level=40)
@ray.remote
def kait_smoke_task():
    return 1
assert ray.get(kait_smoke_task.remote()) == 1
ray.shutdown()
import mlflow
mlflow.set_tracking_uri('sqlite:////tmp/kait-mlflow-smoke.db')
mlflow.set_experiment('kait-smoke')
run = mlflow.start_run()
mlflow.log_metric('smoke', 1.0)
mlflow.end_run()
import wandb
wandb_run = wandb.init(mode='disabled', project='kait-smoke')
wandb_run.finish()
